name: Maello (Spain)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with a green holm oak with a brown trunk and a black dog at its foot, between six black roundels along the hoist and fly.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 1 June 2004 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 28 June 2004); the flag is a yellow cloth with, at its centre, a holm oak with green branches and a brown trunk and a black dog at its foot.

features.role: holm oak with a black dog at its foot
six roundels, three at the hoist and three at the fly
